name: Share
overview: Scripture reveals that all possessions and power ultimately belong to God, as seen in Deuteronomy 8:17 and Job 41:11, reminding believers not to boast in their own strength or wealth. True sharing flows from recognizing God's sovereignty and seeking His kingdom first, as Luke 12:31 teaches. Furthermore, Isaiah 58:6 highlights that God desires acts of mercy that relieve burdens and free the oppressed, reflecting His heart in how we share. The call to share is also connected to the gospel invitation in John 3:15 and the intimate relationship between Christ and His followers in John 10:27, encouraging believers to share both material blessings and the message of eternal life.
